process.title: numwords.py — 整数转英文词（美式、无 and）
process.scope: Owns numwords.py and tests/test_numwords.py only. Implements number_to_words and its tests. Does not touch code39, solids, or any existing file.
process.task:
Create numwords.py and tests/test_numwords.py (new files only; do not modify any existing file). Standard library only; do not import the other modules.

Spec for number_to_words(n: int) -> str:
- Range pinned: 0 <= n <= 999,999,999. n must be int (bool rejected); non-int raises TypeError; out of range raises ValueError.
- Spelling rules pinned: American English, no "and"; all lowercase; grouped by thousand/million; within a group the hundreds place is "X hundred"; tens and ones combine with a hyphen (e.g. forty-two); groups separated by a single space, no leading/trailing spaces.

Acceptance items (each needs a test case):
- number_to_words(0) == "zero"
- number_to_words(5) == "five"
- number_to_words(13) == "thirteen"
- number_to_words(20) == "twenty"
- number_to_words(40) == "forty"
- number_to_words(42) == "forty-two"
- number_to_words(99) == "ninety-nine"
- number_to_words(100) == "one hundred"
- number_to_words(115) == "one hundred fifteen" (no and)
- number_to_words(999) == "nine hundred ninety-nine"
- number_to_words(1000) == "one thousand"
- number_to_words(1001) == "one thousand one"
- number_to_words(1100) == "one thousand one hundred"
- number_to_words(12345) == "twelve thousand three hundred forty-five"
- number_to_words(100000) == "one hundred thousand"
- number_to_words(1000000) == "one million"
- number_to_words(2000000) == "two million"
- number_to_words(100000000) == "one hundred million"
- number_to_words(999999999) == "nine hundred ninety-nine million nine hundred ninety-nine thousand nine hundred ninety-nine"
- number_to_words(-1) and number_to_words(1000000000) raise ValueError
- number_to_words(2.5), number_to_words("42"), number_to_words(True) raise TypeError

Every acceptance example/value above must have a corresponding test case. checks (verbatim): python3 -m pytest tests/test_numwords.py -q ; python3 -m pytest tests/ -q
